snippet.title: Taryn Barker: Demon Hunter  - The Videogame (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
'Become the Hunter and take on the legions of Eskerin Falstaff's demon horde as you venture out to save a girl from sacrifice in this trailer for Taryn Barker: Demon Hunter, an upcoming Metroidvania style game based on the movie. The trailer shows off the various weaponry, upgrades, combat and locations you'll experience throughout.

Taryn Barker: Demon Hunter will be coming soon to various platforms.
